🔍 Traces API

Distributed tracing ingestion and query with OpenTelemetry protocol support

Base URL

{{.BaseURL}}/v1/traces

Endpoints

POST /v1/traces

Ingest trace spans using OpenTelemetry protocol

Headers

Content-Type: application/x-protobuf
Authorization: Bearer <api-key>
X-Trace-Id: <trace-id> (optional)

Request Body

OpenTelemetry ExportTraceServiceRequest protobuf message

{
  "resource_spans": [{
    "resource": {
      "attributes": [
        {"key": "service.name", "value": {"string_value": "my-service"}},
        {"key": "service.version", "value": {"string_value": "1.0.0"}}
      ]
    },
    "scope_spans": [{
      "scope": {
        "name": "my-tracer",
        "version": "1.0.0"
      },
      "spans": [{
        "trace_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
        "span_id": "0123456789abcdef",
        "parent_span_id": "fedcba9876543210",
        "name": "http_request",
        "kind": "SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
        "start_time_unix_nano": "1640995200000000000",
        "end_time_unix_nano": "1640995200100000000",
        "attributes": [
          {"key": "http.method", "value": {"string_value": "GET"}},
          {"key": "http.status_code", "value": {"int_value": "200"}}
        ],
        "status": {
          "code": "STATUS_CODE_OK"
        }
      }]
    }]
  }]
}

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "partial_success": {
    "rejected_spans": 0,
    "error_message": ""
  }
}

GET /v1/traces/{trace_id}

Retrieve complete trace by ID

Parameters

  • trace_id (path) - 32-character hex trace ID
  • format (query) - Response format: json, otlp (default: json)

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "trace_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
  "spans": [{
    "span_id": "0123456789abcdef",
    "parent_span_id": "fedcba9876543210",
    "operation_name": "http_request",
    "service_name": "my-service",
    "start_time": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z",
    "duration_ms": 100,
    "tags": {
      "http.method": "GET",
      "http.status_code": 200
    }
  }]
}

GET /v1/traces

Search and filter traces

Query Parameters

  • service - Filter by service name
  • operation - Filter by operation name
  • start - Start time (RFC3339)
  • end - End time (RFC3339)
  • duration_min - Minimum duration (ms)
  • duration_max - Maximum duration (ms)
  • tags - Tag filters (key:value format)
  • limit - Result limit (max 1000, default 100)
  • offset - Pagination offset

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "traces": [{
    "trace_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef",
    "root_service": "my-service",
    "root_operation": "http_request",
    "start_time": "2024-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z",
    "duration_ms": 250,
    "span_count": 5,
    "error_count": 0
  }],
  "total": 42,
  "has_more": true
}

Rate Limits

  • Ingestion: 10,000 spans/second per API key
  • Query: 100 requests/minute per API key
  • Batch size: Maximum 1,000 spans per request

Error Codes

400 Bad Request

Invalid request format or missing required fields

401 Unauthorized

Missing or invalid API key

413 Payload Too Large

Request exceeds maximum size limit (10MB)

429 Too Many Requests

Rate limit exceeded

500 Internal Server Error

Server processing error
